svg.title: Six common group-work problems on six cards: 1 Who does what? — a pie chart of tasks with a question mark: allocation of tasks. 2 “Sorry, what?” — two phones with a broken signal: communication breakdown. 3 A+ or just a pass? — a signpost pointing two ways: different priorities or goals. 4 Zzz… — a student asleep: lack of commitment or effort. 5 No time! — an alarm clock with a racing hand: time management. 6 Grrr! — two students with an angry zigzag between them: personal disagreement.
